thread:
nina.sales: Vanguard Health RFP arrived — theyre asking for a capability matrix, HSM-backed key control options, and a clear POC commercial. RFP uploaded: https://drive.company/vanguard_rfp_v3.pdf. Who can take tech + sec bullets?

uploader-bot: Uploaded file `vanguard_rfp_v3.pdf` (2.0MB) to #sales thread.

cal.eng: I got infra/connectors. Quick clarifying Q: they mention "air-gapped" installs and HSM-attached keys — do they expect on-prem transfer or VPC peering?

yuri.sec: Security asks: SOC2 Type II copy, HSM/FIPS-140 KMS support, audit log retention policy, DPA/BAA if PHI. Legal sign-off required for air-gapped installs; well need network diagrams and an SOW for HSM integration.

harper.prod: For the capability matrix propose rows: supported model families, deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private), quantization support, throughput targets, monitoring & rollouts. POC plan: 2-week hosted baseline then optional 2-week Private with HSM for key control.

eva.finance: Commercials: suggest a POC credit $10,000 covering hosted + engineering time and first 600GB ingress/egress. Private short trial commit $25k/mo (30-day min). Egress overage $0.08/GB. We can provide an estimate table if they share tokens/day.

nina.sales: Can someone draft one-line RFP answers I can paste for fields: ingestion, residency, KMS/HSM, retention, egress, capability summary, attachments? Need this today.

cal.eng: Drafts (copy/paste):
- Ingestion: Customer may provide data via presigned S3 URLs (24h TTL) or a cross-account read-only IAM role; for air-gapped scenarios we accept encrypted offline media via SOW.
- Residency: Hosted POC data resides in the tenants selected region; Private/VPC and on-prem deployments supported for strict residency requirements.
- KMS/HSM: Customer-managed KMS supported for hosted POCs; HSM/FIPS-140 integration available for Private/on-prem with SOW. Key usage controls and attestation services available on request.
- Retention: Default POC artifacts retention 14 days; audit logs retained 30 days (immutable). Shorter retention configurable for sensitive datasets.
- Egress: POC includes first 600GB ingress/egress; additional egress billed at $0.08/GB. Private deployments follow customer/provider egress billing.
- Capability summary: "Redwood supports hosted, dedicated, and private deployments across major model families with optional int8/int4 quantization; observability includes per-model latency/cost dashboards, eval tooling, and controlled rollouts."
- Attachments: SOC2 Type II (redacted), pricing sheet, POC SOW template, HSM integration brief, sample runbook.

cal.eng: Example presign command for docs:

aws s3 presign s3://vanguard-inputs/seed.tar.gz --expires-in 86400

yuri.sec: Small edits: presigned URLs must be read-only and rotated for multi-batch ingestion. For HSM: FIPS-certified HSMs supported in Private mode only; attestation and key-wrapping options provided under SOW. Security contact: yuri.sec@redwood.ai.

eva.finance: Final commercial sentence to paste: "POC credit $10k (one-time) covers hosted eval and first 600GB ingress/egress; Private short trial commit $25k/month (30-day min). Overages at $0.08/GB; support beyond included hours billed at $225/hr."

harper.prod: Exec blurb: "Redwood proposes a focused POC to validate integration, security posture (including HSM-backed key control if required), and cost/latency tradeoffs. Deliverables: KPI report, recommended serving configuration, and an ops handoff."

nina.sales: Thanks team 44d Ill assemble and send. Please attach SOC2 redacted and HSM brief; Ill include the security contact. ETA 3 hours.
